title: The Day the Viking Age Began
description: June 793: longships reach the monastery island of Lindisfarne.

scenes.narration: This raid is often called the start of the Viking Age.
scenes.image_prompt: Viking longships with dragon-head prows approaching a rocky coast, stormy sky

scenes.narration: It's June 793. Lindisfarne, a quiet monastery island off the coast of northern England.
scenes.image_prompt: small early medieval stone monastery on a green island by the sea

scenes.narration: Monks are at prayer when longships appear on the horizon.
scenes.image_prompt: monks in brown robes looking out to sea at longships on the horizon

scenes.narration: Raiders from Scandinavia leap onto the beach.
scenes.image_prompt: Viking warriors with round shields jumping from longships onto a sandy beach

scenes.narration: They take gold, silver and treasures from the church.
scenes.image_prompt: Viking warriors carrying gold chalices and chests out of a monastery

scenes.narration: The scholar Alcuin writes that nothing like it had ever been seen in Britain.
scenes.image_prompt: medieval scholar writing a letter by candlelight with a quill, worried

scenes.narration: Over the next two centuries, Vikings raid, trade and settle across Europe.
scenes.image_prompt: Viking trading town with longships, markets and longhouses

scenes.narration: They even reached North America. Would you have joined a Viking crew?
scenes.image_prompt: Viking longship sailing on open ocean at sunset
